option_relations.rationale: Hepatic abscess (Staphylococcal) is a broader category that includes hepatic involvement in ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia, which is specifically caused by Staphylococcus aureus.
Liver Abscess (Staphylococcus aureus) is a broader category that includes hepatic involvement in ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia, which is specifically caused by Staphylococcus aureus.

Severe congenital neutropenia (SCN) with hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus is clinically equivalent to ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia with hepatic involvement, as ELANE mutations are a common cause of SCN and the vignette specifies S. aureus as the cause of the hepatic abscess.

Immunodeficiency Disorder (ELANE mutation-associated) is a broader category that encompasses ELANE-associated severe congenital neutropenia with hepatic involvement, as the latter is a specific manifestation of the former.
